validated_results.title: Cadmium burden and the risk and phenotype of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: Hospital-based case-control study investigating dietary factors including dairy products in relation to prostate cancer risk.

extraction.population: Men recruited from four medical centers in Taiwan

sample_size.excerpt: A total of 261 cases (age: 72.1 ± 6.8 years) and 267 controls (age: 71.3 ± 7.2 years) were recruited.
sample_size.location: Results, paragraph 1; total_n derived from reported group counts 261 + 267 = 528

cases.excerpt: Among the 261 cases, these data were available, respectively, for 220 (84.3%) and 210 (80.5%) cases.

design.excerpt: Hospital-based 261 prostate cancer cases and 267 controls with benign diseases were recruited from four hospitals in Taiwan.

timing.excerpt: Using a food frequency questionnaire, both cases and controls reported dietary intake history from 10 years ago, determined by personal recall.

continent.excerpt: Hospital-based 261 prostate cancer cases and 267 controls with benign diseases were recruited from four hospitals in Taiwan.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Using a food frequency questionnaire, both cases and controls reported dietary intake history from 10 years ago, determined by personal recall.
